**Related Work 改动**（原 2 段 ~8 行 → 3 段 ~18 行）：
1. **Model collapse and recursive degradation** — 新增 Fu et al. (Markov chain theory)、Hao et al. (detection accuracy erosion)、Wang et al. (unveiling)、Padmakumar et al. (writing diversity) 等引用，补充了收敛理论和实证关联
2. **Machine-generated text detection** — 新增 RAID benchmark (Dugan et al.)、GPTZero (Liang et al.)、SemEval multigenerator (Wang et al.)、paraphrasing robustness (Sadasivan; Krishna)、cross-mode transfer (Hao) 等引用，覆盖检测方法全景
3. **Data curation, ordinal methods, and watermarking** — 恢复 probing 引用 (Alain & Belinkov)，补充 ordinal regression 和 watermarking 的完整定位

**空间补偿**（net zero）：
- Introduction 贡献列表压缩约 4 行（去冗余修饰词）
- Experiments 开头压缩 1 行
- Discussion boundary cases 段压缩 1 行
- Conclusion 压缩约 3 行

$\Kempirical = 2$ makes a falsifiable prediction: binary curation should suffice, and graduated performance should converge toward binary as the decay steepness increases.
We present this as a consistency check under extreme contamination, not as an independent contribution; at realistic rates ($\leq$50\%), strategy differences remain below 0.3\,pp (Appendix~\ref{sec:dose_response}).
We compare six strategies on 30{,}000 documents (depths 0--5): (i)~\textbf{no-filter}, (ii)~\textbf{binary-ours} ($w = 1 - P(\text{synthetic})$ from 15D LightGBM), (iii)~\textbf{binary-Drayson}~\citep{drayson2025}, (iv)~\textbf{graduated} ($w = \exp(-\alpha \cdot \hat{d})$, $\alpha \in \{0.1,\ldots,0.9\}$), (v)~\textbf{surprisal} (retain above median), and (vi)~\textbf{DSIR}~\citep{xie2023dsir}.
We fine-tune Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA; rank~8, $\alpha_{\text{LoRA}}{=}16$) for 3 epochs on MMLU and HellaSwag across 5 seeds (${\sim}$83\% synthetic; depth~0 retains human seeds~\cite{shumailov2024collapse, dohmatob2024model}).

1	\section{Conclusion}
2	\label{sec:conclusion}
3	
4	We introduced $\Kempirical$ and measured it across 10 prompt-chain configurations spanning six architecture families (1B--8B).
5	$\Kempirical \leq 2$ universally for web text; arXiv reaches $\Kempirical{=}3$ across four families, implying the boundary is text-intrinsic.
6	One-wash laundering concentrates signal at the 0v1 boundary; binary curation halves the MMLU gap under extreme contamination, while graduated strategies offer no benefit beyond $\Kempirical$.
7	Generator-agnostic features enable 80--92\% cross-model transfer ($\rho > 0.90$); neural probes extend $\Kempirical$ by one level.
8	Depth chains beyond 8B, RLHF/DPO-aligned models, and closing the $\Kempirical$--$\Ktheory$ gap remain open directions for future work.

tool_args.old_string:
Binary-ours reduces the MMLU gap from $-$1.53\,pp (no-filter) to $-$0.77\,pp (${\sim}$50\% reduction; $p_{\text{corr}} < 0.05$ vs.\ all alternatives; Table~\ref{tab:tab_filtering_main}, \ref{tab:pairwise_significance}).
The ordering is interpretable through $\Kempirical$: binary filtering exploits the strongest boundary (0v1), while graduated strategies assign weights based on near-random classifier outputs, injecting noise.
Graduated filtering converges toward binary: at $\alpha{=}0.9$, it matches binary-ours on HellaSwag ($p_{\text{corr}} = 1.00$) but remains worse on MMLU ($p_{\text{corr}} = 0.011$); DSIR is indistinguishable from no-filter (Figure~\ref{fig:filtering_strategies}).
At realistic contamination ratios ($\leq$50\%), strategy differences remain below 0.3\,pp (Appendix~\ref{sec:dose_response}); this extreme setting validates $\Kempirical$'s predictive power despite vanishing effect sizes at realistic ratios.

tool_args.new_string:
We introduced $\Kempirical$, the empirical discrimination boundary for recursive synthetic text, and measured it across 10 prompt-chain configurations spanning six architecture families from 1B to 8B parameters.
The central finding is that $\Kempirical \leq 2$ holds universally for web text: a single pass through any tested LLM erases enough statistical signal that second-generation text becomes indistinguishable from all subsequent depths.
arXiv reaches $\Kempirical{=}3$ across four model families, confirming that the boundary is determined by domain structure rather than model architecture.
This one-wash laundering effect concentrates discriminative signal at the 0v1 boundary, with practical consequences for data curation: binary filtering halves the MMLU gap under extreme contamination (${\sim}$83\% synthetic), while graduated strategies that attempt finer-grained depth weighting offer no benefit beyond what $\Kempirical$ predicts.
The 15-dimensional feature set transfers across generators at 80--92\% retention ($\rho > 0.90$ for feature rankings), establishing that depth estimation need not assume access to the generating model.
Neural probes extend $\Kempirical$ by one level, suggesting that richer representations can partially close the gap between $\Kempirical$ and the theoretical upper bound $\Ktheory$.
Depth chains generated by models beyond 8B, evaluation of RLHF/DPO-aligned models, and systematically closing the $\Kempirical$--$\Ktheory$ gap remain important directions for future work.
